content:
Last week, we  tracked more than  65  tech funding deals worth over €6 billion  and over  4  exits, M&A transactions, rumours, and related news stories across Europe.

📊 The top three industries that raised the most were healthtech (€4.6 billion), fintech (€493.4 million), and robotics (€461.6 million). At the country level, 🇬🇧 the UK took first place (€5 billion), followed by 🇫🇷 France (€596.7 million) and 🇧🇬 Bulgaria (€255.3 million).

❗ Be sure to check out the Tech.eu Funding Explorer, free and open to everyone, for deeper insights into funding data, investor activity, company profiles, and market trends. Now, let's get you up to speed on everything that happened last week.

Have a great week!
